title: Maybe: enforce conventions mechanically (clippy config, CI fmt and clippy job)
body: A maybe. Jack has not set up a clippy config or a fmt/clippy CI job before and wants to see what it looks like in practice before committing to it. Scope if taken: clippy.toml or [workspace.lints] in Cargo.toml, and a workflow step running cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy on push. The release workflow runs neither today. Spike first: show what the config and a failing CI run look like on this repo.
